statement:
∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ) (c d : ℝ),
  Continuous f →
    Differentiable ℝ γ →
      Continuous (deriv γ) →
        (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt φ (φ' s) s) → Continuous φ' → cint f (γ ∘ φ) c d = cint f γ (φ c) (φ d)

goal.text: cint f (γ ∘ φ) c d = cint f γ (φ c) (φ d)

instances.evaluation: cos(7) - cos(1) + I*sin(7) - I*sin(1) == cos(7) - cos(1) + I*sin(7) - I*sin(1) (exact)
